name: Fiora Longears
summary: From Menethil Harbor, you sail west across the Great Sea to meet Fiora Longears in Theramore. Red Jack Flint sends you to his high elf contact at the town inn.

sections.title: A Call to the West
sections.body: Many humans, dwarves, and gnomes look upon the Eastern Kingdoms and see old conflicts and damaged earth. At Menethil Harbor, sailor Red Jack Flint urges travelers to board a ship across the Great Sea. He speaks of Kalimdor as an uncharted land of fortune and opportunity. Then he sends you to Theramore to meet his associate, the elf Fiora Longears.

sections.title: Arrival in Theramore
sections.body: Your voyage ends at Theramore, an Alliance port on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. Fiora Longears waits at the town inn for travelers sent by Flint. She trusts his judgment of character and welcomes the Alliance heroes who have just arrived. From there, she prepares to guide you inland toward Ashenvale's ancient forests.

faq.answer: Fiora Longears is a high elf waiting in the inn at Theramore, in Dustwallow Marsh. Red Jack Flint's contact, she greets Alliance travelers arriving from the Eastern Kingdoms.

aliases: where to get fiora longears quest
faq.answer: Red Jack Flint, an energetic human sailor, offers the journey west from Menethil Harbor on the coast of the Wetlands.

faq.q: How do I reach Fiora Longears from Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Board the passenger ship at Menethil Harbor and sail west across the Great Sea to Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: What happens after meeting Fiora Longears?
faq.answer: Fiora welcomes you in Theramore and praises Flint's recommendation. She sends you inland to Astranaar in Ashenvale for the next part of your journey.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Red Jack Flint and Fiora Longears?
faq.answer: Flint calls Fiora his partner across the sea. He scouts eager adventurers in the Eastern Kingdoms, while Fiora receives them in Kalimdor and helps with Alliance operations and inland travel.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance recruiting travelers to Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Kalimdor offers the Alliance vast new territory and resources. Night elven allies there need help defending their ancestral lands from threats such as the Horde and demonic remnants.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this journey links the Eastern Kingdoms with Kalimdor's night elven territories, joining the eastern and western frontiers.
As a night elf, you find Fiora Longears welcoming eastern allies in Theramore and preparing them for the ancient wilds of northern Kalimdor.
